senses.definition: used to express a sudden burst of energy, noise, or quick movement

examples.en: Zap! The lights suddenly went out and everything became completely dark.
examples.vi: Xoẹt! Đèn đột ngột tắt ngấm và mọi thứ trở nên tối đen như mực.

senses.vi: xoẹt; roẹt; bùm một cái

examples: Then the computer went zap and I lost all my work.
wiktionary.gloss: Representing the sound or action of a zap.

phrasal_verbs.gloss: To change television channels, especially rapidly.
To improve (something) by making it more exciting.
